fields.name: Template
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x6D4DF0 creates it as a copy of the empty FixedString constant (with IncRef). The update bg3.exe+0x1D4EB00 (query {eoc::TimelineActorDataComponent, this, ecl::TLPreviewDummy}, stride 4) compares it with TLPreviewDummy+0x7C (ShapeShiftSourceTemplateOverride in Timeline.h); when different it resolves it as a template id through the level / global template manager (bg3.exe+0x1B4EF50), falls back to TLPreviewDummy+0x80 (OriginalCharacterTemplate) when it is invalid, re-applies the dummy component layout (bg3.exe+0x426A420), sets the dummy visual resource, stores the template id into TLPreviewDummy+0x7C and calls ecl::TLPreviewDummy::ReloadVisual. Live: 0xFFFFFFFF (invalid = not shape-shifted) on all 21 instances.

open_questions: The writer of a real value (the timeline shape-shift track) was not located; a live instance during a shape-shift key would read as a template GUID string.
